# Review Gate Checklist: serviceBW ↔ EUDI Wallet Form Connections

**Purpose**: A formal check of the quality of the requirements, done before `/speckit-tasks`. It
covers four areas: the serviceBW integration, security and data protection, the request lifecycle
and failures, and the DO.IT management UI.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Scope**: Settled decisions are checked only for consistent wording (CHK038–CHK041) and are not
reopened:
- no authentication for webhook updates (2026-10-19: webhook mode removed);
- network restriction instead of credentials;
- a shared EUDIPLO tenant for now;
- custom logic deferred.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec define what serviceBW receives when it pulls a completed request whose documents were deleted unpicked after 30 minutes, and whether that answer must differ from "already delivered"? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020, Edge Cases]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The edge case "Documents never collected" now says that a later pull returns "completed" without documents, the same answer as after a delivery (integration contract, research R9).
- [x] CHK002 Is a retention period defined for request metadata (references, statuses, timestamps)? It holds no documents but is linked to a citizen's serviceBW application. [Gap, Spec §FR-020, Plan research R19]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-021 now deletes request records 7 days after the request ends.
- [x] CHK003 Are responsibilities defined for creating, changing and removing team member accounts, including how people who leave DO.IT lose access? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new assumption "Team member accounts" makes the operators responsible, on DO.IT's request, and FR-007 now requires that deleting an account ends its access at once (user).
- [x] CHK004 Are validation rules specified for every field of a form connection (name, serviceBW form, webhook address format and scheme), not only for missing documents and fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §FR-014]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The data model's validation table covers every field: name and serviceBW form are required within their length limits, and the webhook address must be an absolute https:// URL, or http:// under FR-019's exception.
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, so a form connection no longer has a webhook address to validate.
- [x] CHK005 Are empty, loading and error states specified for the overview and the form connection screens? [Gap, Spec US4-1, Plan contracts/ui-screens.md]
  - Note (2026-10-08): contracts/ui-screens.md already listed the overview's states, and now lists loading and error states for the create, edit and details screens as well.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "the serviceBW form it belongs to" defined: what identifies a form, in what format, and whether two form connections may name the same form? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The Form Connection entity now says the serviceBW form is free text, such as the form's name or ID, and that several form connections may name the same form (research R21).
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified how serviceBW supplies the request reference when calling the pull URL, so that the pull URL shown to DO.IT is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-013]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-004 now says serviceBW inserts the request reference into a placeholder in the pull URL (research R12).
- [x] CHK008 Is the representation of field values that aren't plain text (dates, images, structured values such as place of birth or driving privileges) specified for delivered documents? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Plan research R9]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The integration contract and the data model specify it: values keep their JSON type, binary values become base64 strings, and dates become ISO 8601 strings (research R9).
- [x] CHK009 Are FR-010's "trusted issuer" and "currently valid" defined? This includes who maintains the trusted issuers in each environment, and what happens when revocation status can't be determined. [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions "Wallets and trust"]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-010 now rejects a document whose suspension or revocation can't be checked. The assumption "Wallets and trust" says that the verification service's operators maintain the trusted issuers: test issuers now, and production issuers before real citizens use the service.
- [x] CHK010 Is the precision of the 10-minute expiry specified (an exact cut-off, or a tolerance), given that a citizen's answer can arrive right at the deadline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan research R7]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The expiry is an exact cut-off, recorded under Clarifications, Session 2026-10-08. The 10-second grace was removed from research R7, the data model and the tasks.
- [x] CHK011 Does FR-005's "the configuration they started with" explicitly include the connection mode and webhook address? If it does, changing or removing the webhook address mid-request has a defined outcome. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-014]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-005 now lists the requested documents and fields, and the connection mode with its webhook address.
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, so FR-005 lists only the requested documents and fields.
- [x] CHK012 Is "requests already in progress" in FR-006 defined (only pending requests, or also completed requests with undelivered documents), and is the time within which they are cancelled specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Plan data-model "Open requests"]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-006 now defines "in progress". The time within which requests are cancelled is still not in the spec (the plan says about 2 seconds).
  - Note (2026-10-08): The plan's figure is the answer: about 2 seconds, one worker cycle (data model, research R9). The UI tells users "within a few seconds".
- [x] CHK013 Is a "confirmed delivery" in FR-018 defined for pull mode, where serviceBW sends no confirmation after receiving the documents? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-018 now counts the first pull that returns the documents as the delivery, followed by a 60-second repeat window.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Is FR-008's "the same link as a QR code" consistent with the plan, where the QR code encodes a cross-device link that differs from the same-device link? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Plan research R11]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-008 now describes a link for the device that holds the wallet, and a QR code for another device.
- [x] CHK015 Are the two meanings of "unavailable" distinguished consistently: the answer of a deactivated or deleted form connection's URLs, and a request status? Do the spec and the contracts use the same status names, for example "verification failed"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011, Plan research R12]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-006 (the URLs' answer) and FR-011 (the request status) now describe the two meanings separately. The status names are still mapped only in the plan (research R5).
  - Note (2026-10-08): Mapping the names in one place is enough: research R5 and the integration contract's status table both give the API name of each of the spec's statuses.
- [x] CHK016 Is FR-016's retry limit defined for updates that carry no documents (declined, expired, unavailable)? For these, no sharing starts FR-020's 30-minute clock. [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-020]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-016 now sets a retry limit for each kind of update.
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, together with FR-016.
- [x] CHK017 Do FR-020 ("the system") and SC-006 ("the middleware") consistently cover the external verification component that holds shared documents until they are deleted? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §SC-006, Plan research R8]
  - Note (2026-10-07): FR-020 and SC-006 now include the service the middleware uses to communicate with wallets.
- [x] CHK018 Is the plan's option to allow plain HTTP inside a closed network reflected as an explicit exception in FR-019, or does FR-019 rule it out? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019, Plan research R18]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-019 now requires encrypted connections between serviceBW and the middleware, and names the exception the operators can switch on inside the restricted network (user).

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Does SC-004 define its measurement point for pull mode, where serviceBW's own polling interval decides when it obtains the documents? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
  - Note (2026-10-08): SC-004 now measures a pull made 5 seconds after the approval, or the webhook update reaching the address by then.
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, so SC-004 measures only the pull.
- [x] CHK020 Is "100 simultaneous document requests" in SC-007 defined: requests open at the same time, or trigger calls arriving at the same time, and for how long? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
  - Note (2026-10-08): SC-007 now means 100 requests triggered within one minute and in progress at the same time.
- [x] CHK021 Does SC-005 say how the altered, expired, revoked and untrusted test documents are obtained, given that a real wallet can't present an altered document? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Plan quickstart V3]
  - Note (2026-10-08): SC-005 now covers what a test wallet can produce. The new assumption "Checks a test wallet can't trigger" records that rejecting altered documents, and documents presented by someone other than their holder, is left to the service the middleware uses to communicate with wallets.
- [x] CHK022 Are the participants and conditions of the SC-003 measurement defined (sample size, test or real documents, QR code or same-device link)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
  - Note (2026-10-08): SC-003 now names its conditions: at least 10 participants with test wallets, half starting from the QR code and half from the same-device link (user; quickstart V8).
- [x] CHK023 Does SC-002 name observable start and end events for "less than one working day", given that part of the work happens in serviceBW? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
  - Note (2026-10-08): SC-002 now runs from DO.IT agreeing on the documents to the first test request through the serviceBW form that returns them (user).

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are exception and recovery requirements defined for outages of the middleware or of the wallet-verification service? This covers failed triggers, open requests, queued webhook updates, and deletion deadlines that fall inside the outage. [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-008, §FR-016, §FR-020]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new edge case "Outages" describes the recovery. FR-020 and SC-006 accept that deletion can be late by the length of an outage (user).
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, so there are no queued webhook updates to recover.
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a wallet that closes without reporting the citizen's cancellation? The edge cases currently say that cancelling always ends as "declined". [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-011, Plan research R5]
  - Note (2026-10-07): The edge case and US2 scenario 5 now cover a wallet that doesn't report the cancellation.
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for how changes to the trusted issuers or to the document catalog affect existing form connections and requests in progress? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005, §FR-010]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-005 now says changes to the catalog or the trusted issuers reach existing form connections without anyone editing them, and requests in progress keep their configuration (research R2, R4).
- [x] CHK027 Is there a requirement, or an explicit acceptance of the risk, for a request link or QR code that is passed to someone other than the citizen filling in the form (cross-device phishing)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-019]
  - Note (2026-10-07): The risk is accepted for this iteration. A new assumption and edge case say that serviceBW checks the documents belong to the applicant.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Is it specified what happens when the same wallet link or QR code is opened twice, or on two devices? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §FR-018]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new edge case "Link or QR code opened more than once" says a request accepts one answer, from the first wallet to answer.
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for two team members editing the same form connection at the same time? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-006]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new edge case "Two team members editing at once" says the later save wins (user).
- [x] CHK030 Given the all-or-nothing behavior, do the requirements say whether DO.IT must learn which catalog fields some citizens' documents lack, for example an ID variant without an expiry date? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §SC-003, Assumptions "All-or-nothing responses"]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The assumption "All-or-nothing responses" now records this as a known limitation of this iteration (user; research R19 item 3).

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Does the spec require that personal data and request references stay out of logs, or is this only a plan decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, Plan research R8, R13]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-019 now forbids writing document data or request references to any log (research R8, R13).
- [x] CHK032 Are sign-in requirements specified beyond "personal account": password strength, session duration, sign-out, and protection against repeated failed attempts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Plan research R19]
  - Note (2026-10-08): Research R14 specifies the 12-character minimum, 8-hour sessions and sign-out. Limiting failed attempts is out of scope until real citizens use the service, as the spec's "Out of scope" now says (user).
- [x] CHK033 Is an availability target specified for the middleware, which sits on the citizen's path through the serviceBW form? [Gap, Non-Functional]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new assumption "Availability" sets no target for the prototype, with serviceBW's existing process as the fallback (user).
- [x] CHK034 Are the management UI's language, and its accessibility obligations as an internal tool of a public body (for example BITV 2.0), specified, delegated to the design, or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Non-Functional, Plan research R16]
  - Note (2026-10-07): SC-009 now requires WCAG 2.1 AA. The UI language is still left to the Figma design.
  - Note (2026-10-08): That is the answer: WCAG 2.1 AA is specified, and the UI language is delegated to the Figma design (research R16).

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 Are the assumptions about serviceBW's capabilities recorded in the spec, with an owner and a point at which they are confirmed before integration? They are: calling the trigger URL without a body, filling the reference into the pull URL, reading JSON, showing a data-URI image, receiving JSON webhooks within 10 seconds, and keeping the reference secret. [Assumption, Spec Assumptions "serviceBW's role", Plan research R20]
  - Note (2026-10-07): The waiting behavior and the applicant check are now spec assumptions. The other capabilities are still listed only in research R20.
  - Note (2026-10-08): The new assumption "serviceBW's capabilities" lists the rest, and says DO.IT confirms them with serviceBW before the integration starts (research R20).
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, so serviceBW no longer needs to receive JSON webhooks.
- [x] CHK036 Is serviceBW's expected waiting behavior captured as a requirement or an assumption: the polling interval, the stop conditions, and no timeout of its own shorter than the 10-minute expiry? A shorter timeout would leave approved documents uncollected. [Gap, Spec Assumptions "serviceBW's role", §FR-012, Plan research R20]
  - Note (2026-10-07): The spec assumption "serviceBW waits for a final status" now covers this.
- [x] CHK037 Are the external dependencies stated as assumptions, in technology-agnostic terms? These are a wallet-verification service and the city's registration as a relying party. The assumption should also say that the registration certificate may limit which fields can be requested. [Dependency, Spec Assumptions "Wallets and trust", Plan research R19]
  - Note (2026-10-08): "Wallets and trust" now names the separate verification service, and says the city's registration certificate may limit which fields can be requested (research R19 item 1).
- [x] CHK038 Is each accepted risk and open decision recorded with an owner and an exit condition or deadline? These are the shared tenant, declaring retention to the wallet, and the retention of request metadata. [Assumption, Plan research R2, R19]
  - Note (2026-10-07): The retention of request metadata is decided (FR-021). The shared tenant and declaring retention to the wallet still have no named owner or deadline.
  - Note (2026-10-08): DO.IT owns both the separate production tenant and the retention declaration, and both are due before real citizens use the service (user; research R2, R19).

## Ambiguities & Conflicts (settled decisions: wording only)

- [x] CHK039 Is the "no authentication for webhook updates" decision worded consistently across the Clarifications, FR-016, the "Restricted network" assumption, Out of scope, and the webhook contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Assumptions]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The wording matches across the Clarifications, FR-016, the "Restricted network" assumption, "Out of scope", the webhook contract and research R10.
  - Note (2026-10-19): Webhook mode was removed, together with FR-016, the webhook contract and research R10, so the decision no longer applies.
- [x] CHK040 Is the network restriction in FR-017 worded consistently with the plan, including which environments must enforce it and the exemption for local development? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Plan research R13]
  - Note (2026-10-08): FR-017 now says the restriction applies to every deployed environment, test environments included, and that only a developer's own machine is exempt (research R13).
- [x] CHK041 Is the deferral of custom logic stated so that no current requirement depends on it, even though the original input still describes age and licence-age checks? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Assumptions "Out of scope"]
  - Note (2026-10-08): The Clarifications and "Out of scope" defer custom logic, and no requirement depends on it. The age and licence-age checks appear only in the quoted original input.
